ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: cross_trigger_network
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Cross trigger matrix and externally visible cross trigger ports

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: ctm
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Configuration registers for the cross trigger matrix

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: CT_SRC
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Cross trigger destination selection for one CT_Src output port

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CONFIG_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Cross Trigger Source Configuration - CT_Dst select mask

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CT_DST_SELECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects the CT_Dst port(s) to forward on the CT_Src output at this array index. Each bit corresponds to one CT_Dst port, from CT_Dst[0] at bit 0 upwards. Multiple ports may be selected as a trigger source. All selected source ports are then OR'd together to produce the CT_Src output. Set this register to all-zero to disable that output.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: ctp
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Configuration and status registers for the cross trigger port

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects the operating mode of the CTP. 0 - Wire-OR, 1 - Point-to-Point. Program it once, in the same write as INVERT, from the package's cross trigger topology, before any cross trigger matrix route selects or targets this port. While wire-OR is selected the point-to-point handshake is held idle with its request deasserted; after point-to-point is selected, the handshake ignores the CT_Req_in and CT_Ack_in pads until their synchronized levels are valid.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INVERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Inverts the sense of the incoming and outgoing GPIO signals. 0 - No inversion. Wire-OR mode uses active-low signaling with active or passive pull-ups. Point-to-point mode uses active-high signaling. 1 - All inputs and outputs of I/Os are inverted. Wire-OR mode uses active-high signaling with active or passive pull-downs. Point-to-point mode uses active-low signaling. Write it in the same access as MODE.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESET
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: While set, holds the outgoing point-to-point handshake idle with CT_Req_out deasserted and discards core-side cross trigger pulses for transmission. The incoming handshake keeps running. Set and then clear it to recover a handshake deadlock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUSY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates whether a pulse assertion or handshake is currently in progress. 0 - Pulse or handshake is not in progress, 1 - Pulse or handshake is currently in progress

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REQ_OUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Readout of the current CT_Req_out signal value. Reads 0 in wire-OR mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_IN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Readout of the current synchronized CT_Ack_in signal value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REQ_IN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Readout of the current synchronized CT_Req_in signal value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_OUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Readout of the current CT_Ack_out signal value. Reads 0 in wire-OR mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STRETCH_MULT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The number of clock cycles a core-side cross trigger pulse is stretched on the GPIO pin when in wire-OR mode. Whenever a core-side pulse is received, the generated GPIO pulse has a width of (STRETCH_MULT+1) clock cycles.
